title: Lost or stolen documents in Poland
question: What to do if my passport or documents were lost or stolen in Poland?
short_answer: Report immediately to the nearest police station (komisariat) to get an official protocol. Then contact your country's consulate to replace the passport.
conditions: Step 1: Report to police (Komisariat Policji) — get a protocol (protokół zgłoszenia kradzieży/zagubienia)
Step 2: Contact your consulate — they can issue an emergency travel document
For Karta Pobytu replacement: apply at Urząd Wojewódzki with police protocol
Keep digital copies of all documents in your phone or email
Temporary travel document can be issued within 1–3 working days by the consulate
Ukrainian citizens: contact the Consulate of Ukraine in Warsaw (+48 22 621 29 41)
exceptions: EU citizens can travel back to their home country with just a police protocol (no passport needed)
Emergency travel documents are issued faster for booked flights — bring your ticket
If Karta Pobytu was stolen, apply for a duplicate — fee is around 50 PLN
penalties: Not reporting a stolen document increases risk: if someone misuses your identity, you may face complications
Using someone else's documents: criminal offence
